items.html: Indeed, the judgment was below, in the seven lower ones, except that all of it was mingled together, as mentioned. And since it was so, that there was no correction at all among them in the ten Sefirot, therefore, when the light of Ein Sof descended and broke through within them from above downward, the light would descend from Keter to Hochma, and from Hochma to Bina, which is the third Sefira. But when that upper light, which is the secret of complete mercy and complete Hesed, expanded and reached the seven lower ones, which are judgments as above, and from which judgments are awakened, they were unable to receive it, for they are opposites — this one Hesed and that one judgment. And they were annulled by the upper light, and they died, as the verse says, “And Bela died… and Husham died,” etc.
